name: Podcast Pipeline
tagline: Takes an episode from topic research through to a published show
description: Covers the whole production line for an audio programme: it researches the topic, writes a script with a distinct voice for each host, stitches the speech with your branding and an outro, checks the result, then cuts captions and publishes. Built around a beginner-level Spanish show, it handles two-host formats.
author: TheNextGreatEra
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
